'''Brandon Jones''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[January 2001 Columbus tournament (13 January)]] on 13 January 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]], according to David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ columbus-ohio-1-13-01], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
